_purpose: Test multi-faction dynamics, competing goals within party, uneasy alliance against external threat, betrayal opportunities, reputation with multiple factions, shared vs. individual objectives
_comment_tactical: === TACTICAL MODULE - ENABLED (External Threat + Potential PvP) ===
_scenario_hint: Ancient Ritual Site (void_level 7, unstable), three factions (Tempest, Sovereign Nexus, Freeborn Collective) discover pre-Covenant archive simultaneously. External threat: void cultists trying to destroy site. Forced cooperation: must defend site together, but each faction wants exclusive access to archive contents. Tensions: Tempest wants void research, Nexus wants to suppress dangerous knowledge, Freeborn wants to liberate information. Betrayal opportunities: sabotage allies, claim archive, defect to cultists. Success requires balancing shared threat with competing goals.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: Multi-faction party (Tempest vs. Nexus vs. Freeborn), competing individual goals within team, shared external threat (void cultists), reputation tracking with 3 factions, betrayal/defection opportunities, moral tension (cooperation vs. self-interest), potential PvP if alliance breaks
_design_notes.character_innovation: Three characters from antagonistic factions, faction-specific gear (Nexus seal, Tempest void scanner, Freeborn counterfeit IDs), explicit goal conflicts

starting_clocks.name: Void Cultist Assault
starting_clocks.description: Cultist attack waves. At 7 ticks: heavy assault. At 10 ticks: site destroyed unless defended.
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: void cultist assault setback or reversal

starting_clocks.name: Archive Access Progress
starting_clocks.description: Unlocking ancient archive. At 8 ticks: data accessible (triggering faction competition for control).
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: archive access progress setback or reversal

starting_clocks.name: Alliance Cohesion
starting_clocks.description: Team trust level. At 3 ticks: betrayal likely. At 0 ticks: alliance collapses, potential PvP.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: alliance cohesion worsens or time runs out

players.name: Void Researcher Arden
goals: Secure archive data for Tempest void research
Betray alliance if necessary to protect research

players.name: Codex Enforcer Lyss
goals: Ensure archive aligns with Codex doctrine

players.name: Liberator Kael
goals: Broadcast archive contents to all factions (liberate knowledge)
Escape with data copy if alliance fails

notes: ML Training Focus: Multi-faction party (Tempest vs. Nexus vs. Freeborn), competing PC goals (research vs. suppression vs. liberation), shared external threat (void cultists), uneasy alliance mechanics, betrayal opportunities, faction reputation tracking, potential PvP if cooperation fails. Tests underrepresented factional conflict within party, moral tension between cooperation and self-interest, trust/suspicion dynamics. Long campaign (18 turns) allows alliance to form, strain, potentially break. Features exotic weapons: Hollowed Repeater (Void, scales with void score), Shrike Cannon (Glyph-Encoded, +6 DMG).
